situations.title: 통역 서비스 요청 안내
situations.tagline: Let me get an interpreter so we understand each other.
situations.brief: 전화·영상 통역 서비스를 요청하는 절차를 환자에게 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to call an interpreter to help us talk.
It only takes a minute, and it's free for you.
You'll hear them through this phone, in your language.

situations.title: 기본 의사 확인
situations.tagline: Let me ask a few simple questions to start.
situations.brief: 통증·알레르기 등 핵심 정보를 단순화한 표현으로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Pain? Point to where.
Any allergy to medicine? Yes or no?
Show me with your fingers, zero to ten.

situations.title: 통역 통한 동의 확인
situations.tagline: Through the interpreter, let's confirm you agree.
situations.brief: 통역을 통해 검사·처치에 대한 동의를 정확히 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The interpreter will explain the test to you.
Please tell me back what you understood.
Do you agree to have this done? Yes or no?

situations.title: 가족 통역 한계 설명
situations.tagline: I appreciate your help, but let's use a professional interpreter.
situations.brief: 가족이 통역을 자처할 때 전문 통역의 필요성을 정중히 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for wanting to help translate.
For medical details, we use a trained interpreter.
This keeps everything accurate and protects your mom.

situations.title: 언어 선호 확인
situations.tagline: What language do you feel most comfortable in?
situations.brief: 환자의 모국어와 문해 수준 등 언어 선호를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: What language would you like us to use?
Is it easier to read or to listen for you?
We can get materials in your language too.

situations.title: 통역 3자 대화 구조
situations.tagline: I'll talk to you directly while the interpreter helps.
situations.brief: 통역 3자 대화에서 환자를 직접 바라보며 소통하는 구조를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm speaking to you, not to the phone.
Please look at me, and the interpreter will follow.
Tell me in short sentences so nothing is missed.
goals: 통역이 있어도 환자를 직접 바라보며 말한다

situations.title: 방언·소수언어 대응
situations.tagline: Let's find an interpreter who speaks your exact dialect.
situations.brief: 흔치 않은 소수언어·방언 환자를 위해 적합한 통역을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I want to make sure we get the right dialect.
It may take a little longer to find the interpreter.
You're doing fine — take your time.

situations.title: 통역 오역 감지
situations.tagline: That answer seemed short — can we go over it again?
situations.brief: 통역 길이·환자 반응의 불일치로 오역 가능성을 감지하고 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: You said a lot — I want to hear all of it.
Can the interpreter repeat that in full?
Let me ask again a different way to be sure.

situations.title: 문화적 금기 배려
situations.tagline: I can arrange a female nurse if that's more comfortable.
situations.brief: 성별·접촉에 민감한 문화적 금기를 배려하며 처치를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Would you prefer a female nurse for this exam?
I'll keep you covered as much as possible.
Please tell me if anything makes you uncomfortable.

situations.title: 문해력 저하 환자
situations.tagline: Let me explain this out loud instead of on paper.
situations.brief: 문해력이 낮은 환자에게 구두·그림으로 정보를 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll walk you through it out loud, step by step.
Let me draw a simple picture to show you.
There's no rush — tell me if I go too fast.

situations.title: 청각장애 수어 통역
situations.tagline: Let's get a sign language interpreter for you.
situations.brief: 청각장애 환자를 위해 수어 통역을 확보하고 소통 방식을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm arranging a sign language interpreter now.
Face me so you can see my expressions.
We can also write things down together.
goals: 필담 등 보조 수단을 함께 활용한다

situations.title: 통증 표현 문화차
situations.tagline: It's okay to tell me how much it really hurts.
situations.brief: 통증을 절제하거나 과장하는 문화적 배경을 고려하며 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: In here, telling me your pain helps us help you.
You don't need to be strong for me.
I can see you're tensing — is it worse than you're saying?

situations.title: 응급 중 통역 지연
situations.tagline: Help is coming — point to where it hurts right now.
situations.brief: 통역이 늦어지는 응급 상황에서 최소한의 소통으로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Chest? Point here. Yes or no?
Squeeze my hand if the pain is very bad.
The interpreter is coming — stay with me.
goals: 통역 지연 중 핵심 증상을 신속히 파악한다

situations.title: 통역 없는 위기 소통
situations.tagline: No interpreter yet — let's use gestures and this app.
situations.brief: 통역이 없는 위급 상황에서 비언어·번역기로 최소 소통을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm using a translation app — read this.
Nod yes, shake for no — can you breathe okay?
We are helping you. You are safe.

situations.title: 나쁜 소식 통역 전달
situations.tagline: I have difficult news, and I want to share it carefully.
situations.brief: 통역을 통해 사망·중증 소식을 배려 있게 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: The interpreter will help me tell you something serious.
I'm so sorry — his condition is very grave.
Take your time, and ask me anything you need.
goals: 통역으로 나쁜 소식을 정확·연민 있게 전한다

situations.title: 동의능력 언어 복합
situations.tagline: We need consent, but his understanding is unclear.
situations.brief: 언어 장벽과 의식저하가 겹친 환자의 동의 능력을 신중히 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me back what I just explained?
The interpreter will check if he truly understands.
If he can't consent, we'll reach his next of kin.
goals: 언어·의식 요인을 분리해 동의 능력을 평가한다
필요 시 대리 동의 경로를 안내한다

situations.title: 정신과 위기 언어장벽
situations.tagline: I need to understand exactly how you're feeling right now.
situations.brief: 언어 장벽이 있는 자살 위기 환자를 정확한 통역으로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: The interpreter will help me ask some serious questions.
Have you thought about hurting yourself?
You're not alone — we're here to keep you safe.

situations.title: 문화·언어 기인 치료거부
situations.tagline: Let's talk through what's making you say no.
situations.brief: 문화·언어 오해에서 비롯된 치료 거부의 이유를 통역으로 풀어내세요.
keyPhrases: I want to understand your concern, not push you.
There may be a misunderstanding I can clear up.
The interpreter will make sure I explain it right.

situations.title: 이송 중 언어 인계
situations.tagline: Passing along his language needs for the transfer.
situations.brief: 이송 인수자에게 환자의 언어 특이사항과 통역 필요를 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: He speaks only Somali and needs a video interpreter.
He's declined care before due to a misunderstanding.
Always confirm understanding through the interpreter.

situations.title: 퇴원 교육 언어 장벽
situations.tagline: So... I take the white pill when? I don't want to ask again.
situations.brief: 통역을 통해 퇴원 약물과 주의사항을 teach-back으로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me in your own words how you'll take this medicine at home?
I'll go through each step slowly with the interpreter.
There are no wrong questions — let's make sure it's clear.
goals: 통역을 통해 약물 복용법과 경고 증상을 teach-back으로 확인한다
